question: Does a compact affine chart learned only from the early accepted co-adapted c_proj path predict disjoint future endpoints or causal one-step tangents in weight and fixed post-GELU function space?

theory.paper_claim_under_test: An integrated trained-parameter path can occupy a smooth low-dimensional manifold even when the ambient parameter space is large.
theory.distinction: The accepted implementation is an adaptive scaled-right-orthogonal optimizer orbit with a dense weight buffer and fresh dense-gradient support selection; low temporal PCA rank alone does not establish a compact Mapping Networks parameterization.
theory.learned_basis_caveat: Every fitted PCA basis is a diagnostic oracle. Using it as a candidate would be a learned LoRA-like basis and is prohibited.
theory.causal_requirement: All bases are fitted on steps at or before 1782 and evaluated only on steps at or after 1881.

analysis.radial_normalization: normalize every weight to its step-zero Frobenius norm after validating the exact cumulative cosine-LR weight-decay schedule
analysis.endpoint_basis: through-step-zero PCA of normalized discovery endpoint displacements
analysis.tangent_basis: through-origin PCA of exactly reconstructed normalized last-update tangents from discovery snapshots
analysis.last_step_reconstruction: divide by the scheduled scalar decay, invert residual Givens stages in reverse order, then invert primary Givens stages in reverse order; replay forward before accepting metrics

functional_metric.model_state: accepted terminal full-state snapshot at step 2373
functional_metric.reason: one fixed causal-independent metric is shared by every holdout state; validation CE is not used to fit or select a basis

analysis.monitoring: direct foreground polling; no watchdog or callback

outcomes.PREDICTIVE_ENDPOINT_AND_CAUSAL_TANGENT_O: Both integrated endpoints and future task-functional tangents are predictable by an early-fit oracle. This still authorizes only a paper-style fixed random/modulated-map design, never the learned basis itself.
outcomes.SMOOTH_ENDPOINT_WITH_NONTRANSPORTABLE_TA: The integrated path is compact but causal local directions remain state-conditioned; only nonlinear or modulated state-dependent mapping theory remains open.
outcomes.FUNCTION_SPACE_ENDPOINT_WITHOUT_WEIGHT_C: A task-metric quotient is compact although raw weights are not; identify a fixed analytic metric before any structure.
outcomes.LOCAL_FUNCTIONAL_TANGENT_WITHOUT_ENDPOIN: Local functional directions are predictable but do not integrate into one affine chart; a multi-chart/state transition theory is required.
outcomes.NO_PREDICTIVE_FIXED_AFFINE_CHART: The apparent temporal PCA rank is not chronologically predictive; close the fixed affine chart family.
outcomes.INVALID_MECHANICAL_RECONSTRUCTION: Do not interpret geometry until the saved update mechanics or decay schedule are reconstructed correctly.
